_comment: Cross-line calibration policy. Separate from p2e4_candidate_set_audit.json because cross-line is a different population with different evidential strength (~5x weaker gold inclusion); sharing a config would invite sharing a target that was justified for same-line spans only.
witness_admission_rule_rationale: Line division is scribal layout, not textual structure: the same phrase may be written on one line in one manuscript and across a break in another, so a same-line witness occurrence is real evidence about a cross-line gap. Measured effect: raw top-1 agreement 24.2% -> 32.9%, gold inclusion 4.27% -> 7.21%, best achievable selector rate 79.7% -> 81.2%.
calibration_target_rationale: Cross-line tops out near 0.81 under the ratified LAYOUT_AGNOSTIC rule, so same-line's 0.90 is unreachable and would mean permanent abstention. 0.75 widens coverage meaningfully while keeping rank-1 agreement well above the weaker alternatives. The gap from same-line's ~91% is real and MUST be stated beside every cross-line candidate: a cross-line rate may never be displayed as though it carried same-line strength.
calibration_target_note: Ratified from the sensitivity sweep in reports/phase2_p2e9_cross_line_calibration.md, recorded in reports/phase2_p2e9_ratification.md. This target governs cross-line ONLY; same-line keeps 0.90 in configs/p2e4_candidate_set_audit.json and the two must never be pooled or substituted.
candidate_probability_estimand: Among selector-accepted cross-line spans from calibration compositions where this candidate rank exists, the fraction whose intentionally hidden attested middle occurs at that rank. A property of many past comparisons at that rank in this stratum -- never the probability that one particular lost reading is true, and never applicable to same-line gaps.
must_not_be_pooled_with: same-line calibration (P2-E4); the two populations differ by roughly 5x in gold inclusion
calibration_universe_note: Widened from dev-only 2026-07-28. Standing rule: calibration distributions are fit over the declared universe for their phase, typically the full non-test universe. Dev alone left folds with 45/5/1/4 held-out accepts -- three of four carrying no weight. Safe to widen because this calibration consumes NO model: it counts independent witness families in an anchor index, so train compositions cannot leak anything a model was fit on. Folds stay composition-level; bin (discovery) documents stay out; test is excluded and then asserted via contracts.assert_no_test.
